text: The Unique Readability Theorem guarantees that every well-formed formula:
choices: is either a tautology or a contradiction
has exactly one parse tree, so its meaning is a determinate function of its syntax
can be proved from the axioms of the system
is true in at least one interpretation
explanation: Unique readability says each wff has a single parse tree (a unique main connective), so semantics is a well-defined function of syntax. It says nothing about a formula being a tautology/contradiction (option 1), being provable (option 3), or being satisfiable (option 4).
